Arrow Formal Shirt for Women Easy Care 100% Cotton 

Arrow Formal Shirt for Women brings together timeless elegance and modern comfort. Crafted from 100% pure cotton, this Easy Care Shirt is designed to resist wrinkles, making it ideal for busy professionals who value style and convenience. Whether you’re dressing for a meeting, an interview, or a formal event, this Arrow women’s formal shirt delivers a crisp, polished look throughout the day. This Arrow 100% Cotton Shirt offers a smooth texture and breathable comfort, keeping you cool even during long work hours. The subtle shade complements every skin tone and pairs beautifully with trousers, skirts, or blazers, making it a must-have addition to your formal wear collection. The shirt features fine stitching, premium buttons, and a flattering tailored fit that enhances your professional silhouette.

Key Features:

  • Made from 100% Cotton for softness and breathability
  • Easy Care finish – less ironing, more comfort
  • Elegant– perfect for formal occasions
  • Designed by Arrow – a trusted name in professional fashion
  • Ideal formal shirt for women – office wear and business meetings

Why Choose Arrow Women’s Formal Shirts?

Arrow is a premium brand known for its exceptional craftsmanship and fabric quality. The Arrow Formal Shirt for Women Easy Care 100% Cotton exemplifies sophistication and practicality. Its durable fabric, elegant color, and tailored design make it a reliable choice for working women seeking confidence and comfort in every outfit.
